title: SemEval-2027 Task 3: Semantic Change Across Multiple Time Periods
about: Shared task on semantic change across ten time periods, using a multilingual benchmark of about 120,000 human annotations. Evaluation runs 10-31 January 2027; system papers follow in February 2027 and the workshop in summer 2027.

upskill.name: Natural Language Processing (NLP) II
why: "multilingual benchmark of about 120,000 human annotations" (description) → "Multilingual and cross-lingual NLP: low-resource languages, mBERT, XLM-R"

"Natural language processing (lexical semantic change)" (field) → "Text summarisation, sentiment analysis, named entity recognition" as core applied NLP practice; the course does not cover semantic change specifically
